content:
Chapter 228: Alien Race

Gong Zhe used intelligence to keep in touch with Wu Qing. After a few days, the goblins finally built a space transmission channel leading to the goblin-controlled area of the public battlefield in the southern theater at the location of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce branch in Mengzhong City.

The space transmission channel was completed. Before dawn, Gong Zhe ran to Wu Qing to report the good news. At this time, Wu Qing's insect clone had already arrived in Mengzhong City.

This time point was just right for Wu Qing. Even if the goblins built the space transmission channel a few days earlier, the system energy resources were not enough at that time, and the Zerg pioneering army had not been fully upgraded and could not be dispatched immediately.

If it was built a few days later, it would delay time, and the Zerg army that had been fully upgraded would be idle.

Wu Qing didn't say anything to Gong Zhe, but just showed the relationship between the Zerg and the Naga, which made Gong Zhe anxious, speeding up the construction of the space transmission channel and giving away a lot of Zerg intelligence for free.

"Lord! You can lead your army to the public main battlefield of the southern theater at any time!"

"Over there, our reception staff will arrange everything properly!"

"Elder Gong Rui should meet you in person. You can ask the elder for any request you have!"

"..."

Gong Zhe was very happy to see Wu Qing.

The space transmission channel was built, and there were no unexpected situations on the Zerg side. This can be regarded as his credit. With the accumulation of these credits, his status in the tribe can be raised again.

"That's great! The Zerg army is worried about having no war to fight!"

"It just so happens that the army we sent to the Naga tribe fought a few battles, and the Zerg Overlord gave some energy coins. I'll have someone send them to you!"

Wu Qing delivered the Zerg energy coins just right.

It must cost a lot for the Goblin tribe to build a space transmission channel. Now that the Zerg tribe is about to go to the Goblin tribe's sphere of influence, many things in the future still need to rely on the Goblin tribe.

Therefore, Wu Qing was very generous this time and prepared a large number of Zerg energy coins to give the Goblins a surprise and also help Gong Zhe.

Gong Zhe rose from obscurity, all thanks to the support of the Zerg, so he naturally had a good impression of the Zerg, and supporting him was a good choice.

Gong Zhe was overjoyed that his efforts finally paid off.

When a transport host placed boxes full of Zerg energy coins in front of Gong Zhe, Gong Zhe was so excited that tears welled up.

With this large number of Zerg energy coins, his position in the Goblins was completely stable!

He could feel that this was Wu Qing's support for him. All the status and power he had now came from Wu Qing and the Zerg.

"Lord! I can't express my gratitude in words!"

"If you don't mind my low status, I, Gong Zhe, will always be the best friend of you and the Zerg!"

Gong Zhe's small body now has less of the merchant's materialism and more of an inexplicable temperament.

Wu Qing was surprised to see that Gong Zhe's fortune had completely changed, which was equivalent to gaining a lot of luck all at once.

This kind of change may not be seen in other worlds, but in this world, the change in an instant is particularly obvious.

With Wu Qing's perception ability, he was particularly impressed.

This situation indicates that Gong Zhe's future is bright.

This should be directly related to Wu Qing's support this time and his decision to support Gong Zhe in the future.

Wu Qing smiled and said, "I make friends not based on status, but on fate!"

"I hope you become a big figure in the Goblin tribe in the future, don't forget what I said today!"

Gong Zhe said respectfully, "If I am lucky enough to be promoted, it is also thanks to the Lord and the Zerg. How dare I forget what I said today?!"

Gong Zhe said that he wanted to be the best "friend" of Wu Qing and the Zerg. Here, "friend" is just a nickname. He knows himself. Wu Qing's status as the person in charge of the Zerg outside is far beyond his current status, and perhaps he will never be able to match it in the future.

Wu Qing smiled and skipped the topic, saying, "You go first, I also want to mobilize the army and prepare to go to the battlefield!"

Gong Zhe went to the tribe to take credit with excitement. He made the greatest contribution to the good cooperation between the Goblin tribe and the Zerg.

At dawn, Wu Qing mobilized more than 500,000 Zerg pioneers who had completed the upgrade in the Zerg territory and marched to Mengzhong City.

Two hundred thousand Zerg Hydralisks, one hundred thousand Zerg Roaches, one hundred thousand Zerg Zerg Zerglings, fifty thousand Zerg Mutalisks, fifty thousand Zerg Destroyers, ten thousand Zerg Stealth Spiders, plus one hundred Zerg Hosts, one hundred Zerg Queens, one hundred Zerg Blasting Swarms, and ten Transport Hosts, all of which are four-star. This is the lineup of the Zerg Pioneer Army.

According to the standards given by the Naga tribe, the ratio of each star strength in every ten thousand troops is eight thousand for one-star, one thousand eight hundred for two-star, one hundred and eighty for three-star, and twenty for four-star.

If necessary, this army can improve its strength at any time on the battlefield, and no one can see how deep the potential of this army is.

The larger four-star transport host loaded one hundred Zerg Queens and one hundred Blasting Swarms into the loading space, and also loaded some Zerg Workers and supplies prepared by Wu Qing.

As long as this army reaches Mengzhong City and picks up Wu Qing's Zerg clone and his personal guards, it will be complete.

…

There is no formalism among the Zerg. The entire Zerg army can be said to be the incarnations of the Queen and Wu Qing. There is nothing much to say.

As soon as the Zerg army arrived at Mengzhong City, Wu Qing led ten guards on horseback to the branch of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce. On the huge square, there was a tall building.

This building, which looks very simple except for its height, is the space transmission channel built by the goblins.

The space transmission channel is important for its core. There is no fixed appearance. Each tribe will build its own style according to its own needs.

Gong Zhe has already dealt with the Zerg energy coins. In a good mood, he led people to wait by the space transmission channel.

The Zerg army has arrived at the square. Wu Qing did not continue to talk to Gong Zhe. He nodded and took the lead in entering the space transmission channel.

The maintenance and energy supply of the space transmission channel are all the responsibility of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce, and Wu Qing does not need to worry about it.

The space transmission channel in this world is very stable. Wu Qing's Zerg clone entered the channel and came out from the other side in one step without feeling anything unusual.

On the other side of the goblin space transmission channel, there is also a square, at least as big as the square in Mengzhong City.

"Lord Wu Qing! Goblin steward Gong Yi, welcome to the Goblin Management Area of the Southern Theater Public Battlefield!"

A goblin with a temperament similar to Gong Zhe stood beside the space transmission channel to welcome Wu Qing's arrival.

At this time, no one else was using the space transmission channel. There was no one else in the square except for the people who were obviously welcoming the Zerg army.

Perhaps this space transmission channel can only connect to one place at a time, or it may be that Gong Zhe applied in advance and the goblins cleared the field.

Wu Qing got off his horse, had a brief exchange with the goblin steward Gong Yi, and then left the space transmission channel together and came to the square.

A large number of Zerg hydralisks poured out of the space transmission channel and entered the huge square.

"Lord! Elder Gong Rui was going to meet you in person, but just now, the elder suddenly informed me that there was something urgent to do, and the meeting with you had to be postponed!"

"But the elder has ordered that Lord, if you have any needs, just ask, and we will do our best to meet them!"

Gong Yi said to Wu Qing apologetically.

Gong Zhe also said that Gong Rui would meet Wu Qing, and now this matter suddenly had to be postponed. Wu Qing guessed that this was because of the Zerg energy coins he had just given Gong Zhe.

As a scientific research elder, Gong Rui must have gone to grab Zerg energy coins. This time, the number of Zerg energy coins Wu Qing gave Gong Zhe was particularly large, so large that Gong Rui would rather give up meeting him as the main person to build relationships, and go to grab a portion first.

The goblins have gained such a great benefit, and they must give something in return. Before leaving, Gong Rui emphasized to Gong Yi that Wu Qing's requirements must be met, and he could ask him for instructions at any time if he was undecided.

"I don't have any requirements, just tell me who the enemy is and when the war can start!"

Wu Qing didn't want to waste time. These days, the Zerg's combat power has been idle.

"I have arranged the military camp, and you can move in now!"

"If you want to join the war, my tribe can apply for it at any time!"

"This is a public battlefield. As long as it is daytime, the battle will not stop. There are not so many rules and restrictions!"

"A powerful army can directly attack the enemy's lair, and no one will care!"

Gong Yi replied.

Seeing that Wu Qing was listening attentively, he took the initiative to introduce: "The main enemy on the battlefield now is the believers of the evil god Lord of Light!"

"The believers of the Lord of Light are mainly aliens. They are as powerful as the human race in our native camp, and have almost no weaknesses!"

"The one who leads the alien army to fight now is a young archbishop. It is said that he is a legendary figure. He is very extraordinary. He came here just for experience!"

"There are also several powerful people in our native camp. The wars between the two sides have been very frequent recently. Lord, you just caught up!"

"Among them, the bear, wolf and eagle tribes are the strongest. They have all applied for territories and defense zones here, and the investment is very large!"

"The competition among the three tribes is very fierce. They are all races with bad tempers, and conflicts often occur!"

Gong Yi also specifically mentioned the three powerful tribes in the native camp to remind Wu Qing, with a hint of meaning.

Wu Qing just listened and did not express his opinion.

The transmission speed of the space transmission channel is very fast. Wu Qing did not wait for a long time before the Zerg army was all transmitted over.

More than half a million Zerg troops gathered in the square, which still seemed very empty.
